title: One target of every material in RI-WPN05 §A/§B, in a line at 1.5 m, so the 5x7 hitstop grid, the 18 material multipliers and the deflection rule are DRIVEN rather than declared.

loadout._note: The exemplar build. Materials are set per spawn; RI-WPN05 §B owns the multipliers.

note: W1-10 round 3 fixture. Eight passive dummies, one per material row, each at defence 0 and poise 9999 so nothing staggers and the hitstop is isolated from the stagger (RI-WPN05 harness request 6). Round 2's declared limitation — 'no enemy statblock in this build carries a material, so all five are flesh' — is closed: every statblock in game/data/combat/enemies/ now declares one, three of them per hurtbox region, and the fight reads it at hit time through game/src/combat/impact.js. Step to 1.5 m of any of these and swing, and the IMPACT event carries the material, both hitstop clocks, the knockback sign, the deflect flag and the decal.
